title: BYMA 2025 Sustainability Index Inclusion
summary: La entrada BYMA 2025 Sustainability Index Inclusion se publicó primero en IRSA .
body_markdown:
##### The company proudly announces that it has once again been included in the seventh edition of the Sustainability Index (non-commercial) prepared by BYMA.


The Sustainability Index annually evaluates the performance of companies listed on Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos (BYMA), highlighting the 20 companies with the best results in environmental, social, corporate governance and sustainable development criteria.
